title: Irregular timestep inner residual closure diagnostic
method: Solve the same fixed one-cell affine transient equation in fresh MODFLOW6 6.8.0 sessions. Keep all physics, dt, outer closure, inner head closure and API terms fixed. Change only IMS strict residual closure.
diagnostic_logic: If looser residual closure certifies the same machine-precision head while 1e-15 does not, DSW-05 is an inner-linear residual certification effect rather than a timestep-dependent physical error.
gate: At least the 1e-13 variant must converge and remain within 1e-10 m of the exact head; 1e-15 and 1e-14 are characterization points.
forbidden: do not alter DSW-05 preregistered gate
do not recommend a production tolerance from this diagnostic alone
